headline: Mixed Q2, growth contingent on LCA deliveries

highlights: HAL order prospects remain strong with ~INR1.0trn over the next two years across ALH helicopters, Su-30 upgrades, Dornier aircraft and engine programmes.
Execution across LCH Prachand, HTT-40 and engine programmes remains on track, while opportunities in UAVs, AMCA and indigenous aero-engines provide long-term growth levers.
Recent DAC approvals include AoN for Light Multi Role Helicopters (est. value of ~INR200bn) for the Army and Air Force, adding to HAL’s near-term helicopter order pipeline alongside ALH.
Expanding export initiatives across Africa, the Middle East and Southeast Asia provide additional growth opportunities.
valuation: Change in Estimates Current Previous FY28E FY29E FY28E FY29E Rating BUY BUY Target Price 5,943 5,795 Sales (INR mn) 432,399 499,162 438,754 499,600 % Chng.
LCA Mk1A execution visibility is improving, with 14 GE F404 engines received till Oct’26, ~27 airframes built (awaiting final testing) and ~10 aircraft targeted for IAF delivery by Mar’27.
The stock is currently trading at P/E of 30.0x/27.2x on FY28/29E earnings.
